online-3d-viewer 0.18.0 (MIT), bundled with three (MIT) and fflate (MIT) into
vendor/javascript/o3dv.js by bin/build-o3dv.

The WebAssembly importers it loads at runtime are NOT in this file — they are separate
files under public/o3dv/0.18.0/, with their own notices beside them (see the README
there). occt-import-js is LGPL-2.1 and is shipped, unmodified, as one of those files.
